rules: clause-scoped negation: a negation token (no/not/never/without/zero/absent/nor/none) in the composite's own clause before the assertion word suppresses, unless cancelled by an interjection comma, an idiom (no doubt/question/only/just...), or a contrast marker (but/however/yet/although/instead/rather/in fact)
contrastive negation: a pre-composite tail 'rather than / instead of / as opposed to / not only|just|merely' suppresses
split/diagnosis cue in the composite's own clause (split/separat/distinction/leakage/hygiene/two classes) suppresses unless a contrast marker follows it
rejected-hypothesis cue in the clause (rejected hypothesis / as a hypothesis / not proposed / never proposed / hypothetical) suppresses unless a contrast marker follows it
mention object immediately before the composite (bare/literal/quoted/token/pattern/regex/phrase/expression/string/label [+1 word], or mention|discussion|occurrence|instance|use OF the) suppresses

mention frame: a meta word (pattern/regex/scanner/detector/matcher/token/string/phrase/expression/label) followed within 48 chars by match/flag/scan/detect/cover/recognize/spell/look for/search for/appear/occur/show up suppresses, unless an assertion tail (are one / one class / single class / same class / merged into / unified into / treated as one / chosen unit / right unit / unit of analysis) follows the frame
quoted composite: a composite match inside quotation marks in prose mode suppresses
